m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Search high and low - some of them will be trapped in their homes. Hurry!
Thank you for all you've done, stranger. You're totally saving the day!
So many people are hurt! Our healers can't reach them all - and even if they could, our connection to Life magic is disrupted!
You must take a Moss Poultice from Gazhaat's house and tend to the wounded. Hurry, before it is too late!
